subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘EXPLAIN’ is coded as ‘15912141624’. How will ‘SACRED’ be coded in that language?
solution:
The position of letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca433403f2caf9c0de445e1c024f6e7611100931162fe158336534aa26fca97b.png] 

**Logic: Given alphabet place value are arranged according increasing order.**

‘EXPLAIN’ is coded as ‘15912141624’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2aad0ff4710fd2427e5e1e153e3f2ac4fd6d02008d2b5cd2ac9826e1777092b.png] 

Similarly,

‘SACRED’ is coded as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75c8becde3c4c1fd3b3386565c3abd43b32013ce40df41554e5a4a82d3be824d.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"13451819"**
